 Yellow-card risk alarms Santos, 12 players one booking from suspension 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Santos enter the Brasileirão run-in with 12 players one booking from suspension, and only goalkeeper Gabriel Brazão is not expected to play again this year.
 They host Bahia at Vila Belmiro on Saturday at 21:00 Brasília time. According to Globo.com, among the at-risk players who will not feature are Brazão and defender Lucas Veríssimo, a first-choice recovering from a left thigh injury and is expected to return after the November FIFA window.
 OneFootball Videos
 Left-back Escobar could also miss out, he is on two yellows and managing right thigh pain. The Argentine has 16 bookings in 45 games, the most in the squad.
 Neymar and Gabigol are also a caution away, and they lead Santos for goals and assists this season. Neymar has 10 goals and eight assists, Gabigol has 25 and 10, and the number nine has eight goals and three assists in his last eight matches.
 Midfield options are stretched, with booked pair Christian Oliva and Gustavo Henrique key to Cuca’s plans. Arthur and Willian Arão are still out, leaving only João Schmidt and youngster Samuel Pierri for the role.
 Álvaro Barreal has reinforced the back line, filling in at left-back during Escobar’s absence, and remains an attacking alternative.
 Further players on two yellows are Benjamín Rollheiser, often Neymar’s understudy, Thaciano, cover for Gabigol, converted right-back Gabriel Menino and reserve goalkeeper João Paulo.
 Source: Globo.com
